name: typeAdapterValueReturnsNullSafeAdapter
input: ConstructorConstructor instance, Gson instance, TypeToken for String, JsonAdapter annotation whose value is a concrete TypeAdapter class
expected: Returns a null-safe TypeAdapter instance because the annotation value implements TypeAdapter and nullSafe() is invoked on it.

name: typeAdapterFactoryValueReturnsNullSafeAdapter
input: ConstructorConstructor instance, Gson instance, TypeToken for String, JsonAdapter annotation whose value is a concrete TypeAdapterFactory class
expected: Returns a null-safe TypeAdapter instance created via TypeAdapterFactory.create(gson, fieldType) followed by nullSafe().

name: invalidAnnotationValueThrowsIllegalArgumentException
input: ConstructorConstructor instance, Gson instance, TypeToken for String, JsonAdapter annotation whose value is a class neither implementing TypeAdapter nor TypeAdapterFactory
expected: Throws IllegalArgumentException because the class specified in @JsonAdapter does not match either expected interface.

name: typeAdapterReturningNullConstructsNullSafeNull
input: ConstructorConstructor instance, Gson instance, TypeToken for String, JsonAdapter annotation whose value is a TypeAdapter class whose constructor/instantiation results in a null adapter
expected: Returns null because if typeAdapter is null, the nullSafe() method is bypassed and null is returned.

name: typeAdapterFactoryReturningNullAdapterThrowsOrReturnsNull
input: ConstructorConstructor instance, Gson instance, TypeToken for String, JsonAdapter annotation whose value is a TypeAdapterFactory whose create method returns null
expected: Returns null because if the factory produces a null adapter, nullSafe() is skipped.

name: typeAdapterSubclassValueHandlesPolymorphism
input: ConstructorConstructor instance, Gson instance, TypeToken for Object, JsonAdapter annotation pointing to a custom subclass of TypeAdapter
expected: Successfully constructs and returns the null-safe custom TypeAdapter matching the assignable check for TypeAdapter.class.

name: typeAdapterFactorySubclassValueHandlesPolymorphism
input: ConstructorConstructor instance, Gson instance, TypeToken for Object, JsonAdapter annotation pointing to a custom subclass of TypeAdapterFactory
expected: Successfully constructs the factory, calls create with gson and targetType, and returns the resulting null-safe TypeAdapter.

name: primitiveFieldTypeWithTypeAdapterAnnotation
input: ConstructorConstructor instance, Gson instance, TypeToken for int, JsonAdapter annotation pointing to a TypeAdapter
expected: Returns a null-safe TypeAdapter properly instantiated for the primitive TypeToken.

name: genericFieldTypeWithTypeAdapterFactoryAnnotation
input: ConstructorConstructor instance, Gson instance, TypeToken for List<String>, JsonAdapter annotation pointing to a TypeAdapterFactory
expected: Passes the generic TypeToken correctly to the TypeAdapterFactory.create method and returns the null-safe adapter.

name: abstractTypeAdapterClassThrowsInstantiationException
input: ConstructorConstructor instance, Gson instance, TypeToken for String, JsonAdapter annotation pointing to an abstract class implementing TypeAdapter
expected: Throws an exception (such as RuntimeException or InstantiationException via ConstructorConstructor) because abstract classes cannot be directly instantiated.
